name: Bao's Last Cart
description: A street cart welded from salvaged auto parts, parked at the same intersection in Pilsen Slab since 2189. Bao Nguyen-Okafor runs it alone, sixteen hours a day, seven days a week. He sells synth-pork buns for Φ2 each, steamed in a repurposed industrial humidifier that shouldn't work but does. The buns are dense, filling, and taste like almost-pork. They are the best thing you can buy for Φ2 in the southern the Gray Zone, and Bao knows it — he doesn't advertise, doesn't negotiate, doesn't make small talk. You hand him two quanta, he hands you a bun. The line never stops.
